name: Vice Got a Price!
chapter: After the other 54 trophies.

steps.text: Clear the other 54 trophies in single-player. Nothing on the list is online or tied to a difficulty mode.
Most of the time is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Guides put a full platinum run near 200 hours.
Keep cheats off the save you are using. Published notes say cheats shut off both trophies and saving.

name: Just Like Paradise
chapter: Chapter 1, mission Gone Fishing.

steps.text: Play the early Chapter 1 mission Gone Fishing through to the end.
This is a story bronze. It shows up on a normal pass of that mission and is not a side objective.

name: Paradise Lost
chapter: Pops as Chapter 2 begins.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1. The published line is only that.
Walkthroughs say the pop is on the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, rather than on the Chapter 1 credits.

name: T**s Ass Drug Money
chapter: Pops as Chapter 3 begins.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy name is published with the asterisks.
It is reported to unlock as Chapter 3 opens, after Welcome to Vice City.

name: Vice City, Baby!
chapter: Early Chapter 4, after two missions.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 story.
The unlock is placed after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

name: Top Of The World, Ma
chapter: End of Chapter 4.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4. This bronze is separate from the gold for the final mission.
One walkthrough ties the pop to the last Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
chapter: Last story mission, after Chapter 4.

steps.text: Beat the last story mission. That is the whole requirement, and it is the second gold.
There is no mission replay. Keep a manual save from just before the finale if you want another ending.
Chapter notes put that finale in Chapter 5, after the Chapter 4 trophy.

name: Trust
chapter: Chapter 2, Breakfast Run.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
Partner switching opens around this point, which later pair trophies need.

name: Break the Bank
chapter: Chapter 3, The Cartel Heist.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist.
It is a story bronze. You do not need a flawless heist, only the mission clear.

name: Family Matters
chapter: Chapter 4, Child's Play.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
Guides describe it as the rescue job in that chapter. Clearing the mission is enough.

name: DWNFALL
chapter: Chapter 4, Headliners.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
Walkthroughs frame it as helping with a launch party. The bronze is for completing that mission.

name: Hi-Jacked
chapter: Chapter 4, VCIA Takedown.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown.
This is the scripted airport job. The free-roam passenger-jet theft is a different trophy.

name: Snow Storm
chapter: Chapter 5, Operation Savage Glory.

steps.text: Finish Operation Savage Glory.
Guides place that mission in Chapter 5, after the Chapter 4 story set.

name: A Long Road
chapter: Checklist opens after the credits.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Work you did earlier already counts.

The list is partial on purpose. Examples from the checklist: any 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, and 15 of 18 meditations.
A few categories do want everything, including robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races, and Bret's hunting jobs. Nothing on this checklist is reported as missable.

name: Cunning Stunts
chapter: Any time. 100% wants 300.

steps.text: Finish any 250 stunts. Jumps, bridge flights, knife flights, and base jumps all count toward the same total.
Track them under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or from the map's stunt list. Doing the stunt once is enough. Extra challenge goals on the icon are not required.
Keep going to 300 if you are chasing 100%. Bridge passes are called out as the quickest batch.

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
chapter: Spread across the story and free roam.

steps.text: Open Progress, then Activities, and try each type once. The in-game tracker is reported as nine types.
The set guides list is fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, a basketball hoop, an arcade game, a race or drone race, and one stunt.
Blue activity icons show up as you clear map fog, and a normal platinum run covers each type without a separate grind.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
chapter: After ranges are on the map. Required for 100%.

steps.text: Earn gold on every shooting-range challenge. The trophy text does not allow you to skip any.
The matching 100% line is 42 of 42 range golds, so this silver and that checklist box are the same job.

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
chapter: When drone races are marked. Stricter for 100%.

steps.text: Win one Top Fun drone race at each location. One win per site is what the trophy asks for.
Guides count 14 locations. The 100% checklist is tighter and wants all 42 drone time trials, not just one win per site.

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
chapter: Street and event races, any time they are open.

steps.text: Win 20 different races. Repeating one course does not add a new race.
Published maps list about 40 unique races. The 100% checklist only needs 30 of those wins, so this bronze comes first.

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
chapter: After Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, then wait for his text.
The text marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Beat him there.

name: Stick Fiddler
chapter: Home TV from Chapter 1, or arcade cabinets later.

steps.text: Finish every level of one video game. You do not need the extra challenge goals.
Three games sit on the TV at home, including during Chapter 1: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, and Time Jackers Rewind. Bang For Your Buck is on cabinets around the map.
The home set can be locked during some story stretches. It is available again in free roam after the credits.

name: Road to Rehabilitation
description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
chapter: Lucia only. Marked in Chapter 3, Belville.

steps.text: As Lucia in Chapter 3, take Andy's call. Her home in Belville is then marked.
Play her strand through to the last job. Guides list five stops, ending at the warehouse meetup.
The strand is still on the map after the credits. It does not count as one of the eight Strangers and Freaks.

name: This Was No Boat Accident
description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
chapter: Starts in Chapter 1 at Key Lento. Pauses, then returns.

steps.text: After Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call. His shop in Key Lento uses a green KR marker.
Dive the wrecks he marks, use the metal detector on the seabed, and return the finds. His strand is seven wrecks.
He drops off the map when Chapter 1 ends, then texts again in Chapter 2 or 3. Calling Brian as Jason can bring him back sooner. The trophy is still available after the story.

name: The Lone Rider
description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
chapter: After Chapter 2 Coffee Break. Thrillbilly Mudclub.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to Billy at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish his five jobs, through Hometown Heroes. That last job is the trophy.
His strand stays available after the credits and is not one of the eight stranger strands.

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
chapter: Open world. Watch Yago's timed race in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Finish eight stranger strands. Named quest givers with their own trophies, such as Andy, Billy, and Tyrone, do not fill this counter.
Strands guides have confirmed include Kirk's skunk-ape hunt, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago's street races, and Pilot Pete's deliveries. More strands are still being listed.
Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass. One checklist calls it the only way to lock this silver. Another guide says stranger strands remain after the story. Do the race when it appears.

name: Supply & Demand
description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
chapter: After Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.

steps.text: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS so you have the key cloner and have already delivered Randy one sports car.
Fill Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars. You can also scan traffic with WAiNK and drive matches to his green RK garage in west Vice City.
The list is still open after the credits. Delivering a car in better shape pays more, but the trophy is for finishing the strand.

name: Spin On This!
description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
chapter: Jason only, after Chapter 3 Here, Kitty Kitty.

steps.text: As Jason, after Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy the Kitty Litter labs Tyrone marks in Vice City.
His follow-up, also called Spin On This, is the job that pops the trophy.
The labs stay available after the story. This strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks.

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
chapter: Spots across the state. Both characters after Coffee Break.

steps.text: Meditate at every marked spot. Progress sits under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Guides count 18 spots, and the same spot can count again if the other character meditates there.
You cannot finish the pair meditations until both characters can travel together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

Early guides say a Chapter 1 balcony session at Jason's house, the morning after Down to Earth, may be required and then vanishes. A 21 November checklist says that session is not counted and old spots can be revisited. Do the balcony one anyway while you still live there.

name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
chapter: Jason only, after Chapter 2 Coffee Break.

steps.text: As Jason, answer Bret Vogel's text after Coffee Break and meet him in Lummox County. Lucia does not get the text.
Hunt the animals on his Target Deck and bring them back. The deck list is under Map, Activities, Target Deck.
100% wants all 15 target decks, so this bronze falls out of that work. Which single animal flips the trophy is still being checked. A clean shot pays more but is not required to finish a request.

name: Don't Touch My Deck
chapter: Any time. Grab Starlet Motel cards before Checking Out.

steps.text: Finish any three collectible card sets. Guides map 18 sets in total.
Two cards, Vicki and Victor Maravilla, sit in the Starlet Motel and leave with it at the Chapter 2 finale Checking Out. Pick those up while you still have the room.

name: You WAiNKer!
chapter: Any time after the WAiNK app is on the phone.

steps.text: Scan 100 world spots with the WAiNK app. Any 100 count. There are more than 100 in the state.
Published groups include landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, and No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel. This is separate from scanning vehicles.

name: One Last Thing
chapter: Leave until late. 100% wants 70 of 80.

steps.text: Complete 50 challenges. Open Progress, then Challenges, and use the completed tick while you scroll.
There are 80. Many fill in while you do other trophies, so check this near the end and pick the short ones you still have.
100% asks for 70 of 80, so the bronze pops before that box is full.

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
chapter: After Coffee Break, once you can call your partner.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner in, then cause enough trouble to hit four stars.

The trophy waits until you leave the red heat zone, not merely the flashing search ring. A fast bike helps. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is one route guides use because the helicopter loses you.

A large bank vault always starts at four stars, and those vaults are required for 100%, so this often pops during that escape. Do it before the finale if you are unsure the ending still lets you play as both.

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
chapter: After Coffee Break. Easier once jewelry stores are open.

steps.text: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the wanted level never drops. Stay in the flashing chase, not only the red heat zone.
The pop is delayed, about half a minute after you leave the third shop. If it does not come, hit a fourth shop. Take a few items in each store, and crack the back safe if you can.
Three jewelry stores in north Vice City are a known route, after Yasmani's jewelry jobs in Chapter 3. Finish pair jobs before the finale if your ending might split the characters.

name: Whip It Good
chapter: From Chapter 1, once WAiNK can scan traffic.

steps.text: Discover 100 different vehicles. Point WAiNK at traffic and scan. You do not have to drive each one.
Check totals under Progress, Vehicles. Include boats and aircraft when you see them.
100% wants 200 of 277 base models, so this bronze arrives well before that box.

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
chapter: Easier at higher Focus. Gang sites work.

steps.text: While aiming a gun, trigger Combat Focus and drop five enemies before that one use ends.
Raise the Focus bar first (food, a wash, or Adrenaline). Use a full-auto rifle at a gang operation, up close, in body armor. Police, soldiers, and civilians are reported not to count.
Focus has four levels, shown on the character page. Ranges, golf, pool, fishing, and headshots raise it, so the trophy gets easier later.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
chapter: Free roam at Vice City International Airport.

steps.text: At VCIA, take a large passenger jet that is attached to a boarding bridge. Jets parked out on the field do not count.
Gates E3 and E4 are the easy pair. Stairs by the bridge lead into the plane. Go up to the cockpit, back onto the runway, and take off.
The pop is delayed. Fly about a kilometer away from the airport. Save first. The police arrive quickly.

name: Challenging Tank
chapter: Mile Zero Air Station, south-west map edge.

steps.text: Steal a military tank. The line about Rhinos is the hint.
Tanks sit on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Get in and fire on the soldiers there until the trophy pops. Save before you enter the base.

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
chapter: After Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 so you own the Snap Gun and jewelry stores are marked.
Use the Snap Gun on the back door. Kicking the door sets off the alarm. In the back room, read the safe code, empty the safe, wipe the camera footage, and shut off the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a known quiet target. The trophy pops shortly after you leave unseen. Reload if anyone spots you.

name: Maximum Withdrawal
chapter: After Chapter 4 optional job That's Where The Money Is.

steps.text: Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. It teaches the vault job and counts as your first one.
After Yasmani's earlier payday-loan work, pay him for security-van tips. Follow the van, enter while the guard has the vault open, and hand a bag to your partner when you cannot carry more.
Any five vaults unlock the silver. 100% wants all eight large-bank vaults, so the trophy comes along the way. Leaving the red heat zone is part of the escape.

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
chapter: Same Chapter 4 intro as the bank vaults, or earlier in Vice City.

steps.text: Rob an armored truck and get out of the red heat zone. Clearing a large-bank vault during That's Where The Money Is counts, because you tail the truck first.
For an earlier attempt, block a truck near a Vice City bank, stick a bomb on the rear door, and blow it. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
You will hit every large bank for 100%, so this bronze is hard to miss if you finish that checklist.

name: The Goodtime State
chapter: Any time. Fastest by air after you can fly.

steps.text: Remove the black fog from the whole Leonida map.
A plane is the quick way. Fly over every dark patch until the map is fully drawn in.

name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
chapter: Yellow icons as you explore. All 39 are needed for 100%.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation from each gang. Guides count nine gangs.
Yellow icons appear when you get close, and some are marked by the story. Check Progress, Gangs, for how many of that gang's sites you have hit.
100% wants all 39 operations, including their key valuables, so this bronze pops during that cleanup. Sites come back if you missed a valuable, but the wait is long.

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
chapter: Ocean Beach rooftop bar, any time you can reach it.

steps.text: Go to the rooftop bar on Ocean Beach. One write-up names the Ocean View Hotel: pool level, Rooftop Access, then the lift.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while you are still at the bar, with the view in front of you.
Output Lag still files this trigger as unconfirmed at launch, so if the martini does not pop it, try the bar again rather than assuming a story flag.

name: Capital Offense
description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
chapter: After the key cloner in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Get the key cloner from the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy.
The walkthrough that films this trophy uses the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City. Hack it, drive forward, and go straight through the glass.
The pop is a little late, once you are out on the street. Other cars in that room are reported not to count. A second guide still marks the trigger unconfirmed, so stick to that blue car.

name: Let’s Go Bowling
description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
chapter: Chapter 2 optional hit at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn.

steps.text: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is the Kolt and Associates alley. The Chapter 2 optional job Hit Kingpin Bowling marks it.

Take three key items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The safe takes code 0300 or a sticky bomb.
Escape the police after the third item. You can leave and come back when the robbery icon returns, so missing one item during the mission does not kill the trophy.

name: Personal Best
chapter: After Coffee Break. Train both characters.

steps.text: Max out Strength on Jason and Lucia at the same time. The heart icon on each character page shows the stat.
Buy a gym membership and always call your partner first. The partner trains while you do, so one workout advances both.
Switching opens after Coffee Break. If an ending might limit who you can play, finish the pair workouts before the last mission.

name: Actions Speak Louder
chapter: Passive across the whole game.

steps.text: Log 500 actions that move your criminal profile. The trophy's own counter shows the tally.
Turn on criminal-profile HUD notices so the small face appears when something counts. Stealth finishes, limb shots, kills, and messy escapes all feed different tiers.
Robberies and fights usually fill it during a 100% run. If it is still short, driving through crowds is the fast farm. Stay out of the permanent Irredeemable tier if you can.

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
chapter: After Chapter 3 Credit Check. Lucia, alone, in Little Cuba.

steps.text: In the prologue Lucia robs a payday-loan store. This trophy is for robbing that same store again.

After Credit Check you have payday-loan jobs and the dye-pack jammer. Go alone as Lucia, without Jason, to the payday loan in Little Cuba. Clear the room, take all three drawers, and run away on foot until you are out of the search area.
Driving off is reported not to count. Output Lag still lists the trigger as unconfirmed, so follow the on-foot Little Cuba route if a vaguer attempt fails.

name: The Truth Is Out There
chapter: Night event in Kelly County, or a second unconfirmed lead.

steps.text: One filmed method is a night UFO north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 a.m., and you go alone. A blinking car on the roadside means the event can start. If the car is missing, leave and come back.
Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light. The craft drops a woman. Talk to her, agree to help, and walk her back to the car.

A second guide still calls the trigger unconfirmed and also mentions a one-time graffiti code in a Crosstown stairwell that may open a ground-floor safe. Try the motel road first, and save before you hunt the blinking car.

name: Ten Pin
description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
chapter: Any crowded street, on a bike.

steps.text: Ride a motorcycle or a bicycle and knock down 10 pedestrians with a melee hit inside 60 seconds.
Vice City sidewalks and the Ocean Beach boardwalk are the crowded spots guides name. Ride slowly alongside people rather than at full speed.
Output Lag still lists this one as unconfirmed, so if a car or a weapon swing does nothing, switch to a bike and count ten kicks.

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
chapter: After Chapter 3 Credit Check. Big money after bank vaults.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check so you have the dye-pack jammer. Marked bills come from banks and payday-loan jobs.
Sell those bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City is listed as the best rate. The $250,000 adds up across trips. You do not need it in one drop.
Large vaults, after That's Where The Money Is, pay up to about $205,000 each, so a 100% robbery run covers this.

name: Treat Yo Self
chapter: Any time shops are open. Spend before Chapter 1 wipes cash.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across shops. Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the expensive shortcuts.
The tally is every shop type together, not one store. Mod shops, Pay 'n' Spray, Ammu-Nation, clothes, and salons all count.
Starting Tourist Trap at the end of Chapter 1 wipes the cash you are carrying. Buy weapons and clothes before that mission if you have money to spare. Purchases stay with you.

name: Little Boxes
chapter: Vice City Real Estate app, after Chapter 2 Daily Driver.

steps.text: After Daily Driver, the Vice City Real Estate app is installed. Buy the garages from the phone.
Only the eight garages you purchase count. The four the story hands you do not. The eight together cost about $160,000.

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
chapter: After Chapter 2 Moses. Needs garage space.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app arrives with the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Each registration needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.
At the start, drive an untracked stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register. Cheap cars keep the fee down.
From Chapter 3, cars with a standard tracker can also be registered at a Pay 'n' Spray.
